limitations: Development evidence on independent noise draws of one fixed synthetic trajectory, not public accuracy.
Marginal Gaussian intervals; per-axis Wilson intervals are not simultaneous family-wise guarantees.
All returned fits, including stalled fits and failed quality gates, remain in coverage; exceptions remain in the denominator.
No interval inflation is fitted on these evaluation draws; the 0.1x std control is reported separately.
Known-plane runs condition on the plane map; synthetic_bag runs rebuild the complete front end on every independent recording.
